description: Operator scaffolding for Claude Code, built without writing the code. The free MIT foundation of the Clayworks operator system, for builders without a coding background.

plugins.name: clayworks-lite
plugins.description: Operator scaffolding for Claude Code: three skills (Nudge SQLite reminders, multi-memory routing decision tree, heartbeat-pattern concept) load on install, and a UserPromptSubmit hook surfaces due Nudge reminders automatically. Annotated hook examples for the eight most-used hook events, a CLAUDE.md starter template, a composed settings.example.json, worked configurations, and design-rationale docs ship to disk for you to reference, copy, and customize.
